title: Twenty women had breasts removed unnecessarily during cancer treatment, NHS trust admits
description: The women were among hundreds who were harmed by their treatment at County Durham health trust.

description: A NHS trust in north-east England told the BBC that 20 women underwent mastectomies that could have been avoided.

title: War may be coming. Are we psychologically ready?
description: The military and government say the risk of conflict is growing, but we may not be mentally ready for it

title: Met was negligent and reckless, sisters of 'Putney pusher' suspect tell BBC
description: Nicholas Brandram's family say he was innocent and "took his own life after months of immense pressure".

title: Charles 'sounded giddily elated' after Diana died, Earl Spencer claims
description: Buckingham Palace has strongly pushed back against claims in a new book by the late Princess of Wales's brother.

title: US fans with Ed Sheeran tickets left torn over Macklemore controversy
description: With Sheeran's next gig this weekend, some ticket holders said they were in two minds about going.

title: New wild cat species discovered - with only one known living member

title: British woman rescued in Malawi shootout that left four suspected kidnappers dead

title: UK's 'dismal' Eurovision song choices to be examined by MPs
description: It comes after the UK's entry Look Mum No Computer came last in May's final, scoring just one point.
